cards.card_text: Then there's a bronze snake called Nehushtan, the one Moses made back in the wilderness (Numbers 21:9).
cards.verse_text: He also demolished the bronze snake called Nehushtan that Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had burned incense to it.
